epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

QA run record, run on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「如果都落地了，就更新最新代码，使用右侧浏览器完整的测试验证」; filing: 「发记录并立卡」. It re-runs the seven ADR-0146 items of #29560 after #29563, #29564, #29566, #29567, #29568 and #29569 landed. The record is text only.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `main` at `322cf9068f`. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm console:build`. The console is this tree's own build, served at `/_console`.
- Boot: `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on the showcase, port 3781, own file database and `OS_HOME`, `OS_PORT` exported. The CLI item ran on a second database and port 3782.
- Browser: the desktop app's built-in browser pane, driven by hand, one item at a time (sequential).
- Personas: the seeded admin `admin@objectos.ai`, and one member made with admin create-user and change-password.
- The customize legs ran under one uptime (863 s at the check). The boot was then restarted once on purpose, with every customization published.

## Scope

Selector: `adr-0146-new-items`, the same seven ids as #29560, each resolved by id through `scripts/checklist-select.mjs`.

| item | revision |

| platform-core.customization-pair-ensure-door | 2 |
| studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display | 2 |

Not run here: the live spec `ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts`.

## Per-clause verdicts

### platform-core.customization-pair-ensure-door (r2) — PASS

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | pass | 201 with `showcase_custom`, `^0`, `created: true`, `writable: true`; the pair's manifest agrees. |
| 1 | pass | 200 with `created: false`; the pair's read is byte-identical before and after. |
| 2 | pass | 400 body, 400 query, 400 pair as base, 404 not installed, 409 writable, member 403 PERMISSION_DENIED naming `manage_metadata`. The list gained only the run's fixture. The member's first call answered PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED, a fixture step (change-password), not a verdict. |
| 3 | pass | 409 starts `Delete the customization package "com.example.qa-pair-base.custom" first` and names its export; the base still reads 200; pair DELETE 200, then base DELETE 200. |
| 4 | pass | DELETE of the showcase answers 422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED with its pair installed; both stay listed. |

### studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display (r2) — FAIL

Variants: `showcase_ops_dashboard`, `showcase_hours_by_status`, `showcase_task.in_progress`.

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | pass | Customize sent no metadata write on any variant. The first edit sent one ensure (201, then 200), then the draft PUT naming `package=com.example.showcase.custom` with `overrides: {package:'com.example.showcase', basedOn:'0.1.0'}` and no `_` keys. No write named the base. |
| 1 | pass | The bare, base-named, list and `/layers` effective reads carry the edit and agree; `/layers` code is unchanged from step 1. |
| 2 | pass | As the member: the dashboard and report show the edited label, and the task list drops Due Date, with no server restart. After restore, read as the admin: the dashboard shows its shipped title and the task list has Due Date again. The report's restored render was not opened; its reads equal the baseline. |
| 3 | pass | `studio-override-chip` reads the overrides sentence naming ObjectStack Showcase; its title names 0.1.0. |
| 4 | **fail** | The pair's export carries each override with its block. The base's export carries the view byte-identical, but the dashboard and the report are **absent**: dashboards 3 → 2, reports 4 → 3. Reproduction below. |
| 5 | pass | Cancel deleted nothing. Confirm sent the two DELETEs at the pair, 200 each. All four reads and the base export then equal step 1 byte for byte, for every variant. |
| 6 | pass | Every variant offers Customize on the read-only base; clauses 0–3 and 5 hold on each. The dashboard and report fail clause 4 only. |

### studio-authoring.package-extension-field-c (r2) — PASS

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | pass | The preview reads `region__c`; one ensure, then the extension draft PUT with exactly `{extend, fields: {region__c: {type:'text', label:'Region'}}}`; no object PUT. `tier__c` joined the same extension with no second ensure. |
| 1 | pass | The object read lists both beside the shipped fields; the pair's extension read returns them; a task created with both values reads back EMEA / Gold. |
| 2 | pass | A label edit saves `fieldPatches: {assignee: {label: 'Assignee QA'}}` alone; `required` is disabled; `field-base-patch-only` names the whitelist. |
| 3 | pass | `note__c` outside the pair and `plain_note` in the pair each answer 400 VALIDATION_ERROR located in `issues`; neither is stored. |
| 4 | pass | The hint names `region__c` as taken; `add-field-create` is aria-disabled. |

### automation.package-flow-override (r2) — PASS

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | pass | Customize sent nothing; one ensure, then the flow draft PUT at the pair under the base's name with the block; no toggle and no ledger write. |
| 1 | pass | `_status` has one row; the bare read serves the override; the next change started exactly one run, stepping `start`, then the renamed node. |
| 2 | pass | Stronger than the steps: a base run paused at `manager_review`, then an override renaming that node to `manager_review_pin` was published, then the request was approved. The run completed on `start`, `manager_review`, `needs_exec`, `exec_review` (skipped). The next run took `manager_review_pin`. |
| 3 | pass | The switch posted `{enabled:false}` and `{enabled:true}`, 200 each. Off: no run. On: the next run took the override's node. The ledger row has `package_id com.example.showcase`. One switch is drawn. |
| 4 | pass | Two DELETEs at the pair, 200 each; the chip is gone; the bare read has no overrides key; the next run took the base's `manager_review`. |
| 5 | pass | After the restore, New similar answered 200 with status `obsolete` and `packageId com.example.showcase.custom`; the console opened the copy, Added, in the pair. See the second finding below for New similar while the override is live. |

### cli.packageless-overlay-ceremony-and-close (r1) — PASS

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | pass | Exit 0, `apply: false`, `rows: []`; row and pair counts unchanged. |
| 1 | pass | The staged row reads `movable`, pair `com.example.showcase.custom`; nothing written. |
| 2 | pass | `{"error":"confirmation_required","hint":"pass --yes"}`, exit 1; the row unchanged. |
| 3 | pass | Moved with `overrides {package, basedOn:'0.1.0'}`; no package-less row remains; after a boot the bare read serves the staged label and `/layers` code stays the shipped one; a re-run lists nothing. |
| 4 | pass | The package-less PUT and DELETE and the base-named PUT each answer 403 naming the pair; the item is unchanged after each; the declared PUT into the pair answers 200. |

The first staging wrote the body as a BLOB (sqlite `readfile`), and that move failed spec validation with the row kept. That was the run's own staging error, corrected with `CAST(... AS TEXT)`, not a verdict.

### studio-authoring.package-customization-counts-and-marks (r2) — PASS

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | pass | Served counts 4 overrides, 2 extensions, 1 switched off; the card reads 6 customized, 1 switched off; the pair link opens the pair's Data, the switched-off link the Automations pillar. |
| 1 | pass | The directory total reads 6. Dashboard list: one row marked Customized, the filter leaves 3 → 1. Flow list: Customized and Added marked, the filter leaves 33 → 2. |
| 2 | pass | The landing asks the read-only base only, with a writable card present. A writable package's area asks, answers zero and draws no total, mark or filter. The pair id answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming its base. |

### platform-core.setup-metadata-redirects-to-studio (r2) — PASS

| clause | verdict | evidence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | pass | Each URL's first history entry is its `/studio/~all/metadata/...` target. The lists stay on `~all` (#29566 holds), confirmed on full load for `/apps/setup/metadata/object`. |
| 1 | pass | `?package=` opens the leg, then the Data pillar; `?scope=environment` keeps the cross-package leg; `?review=1` and `#fields` survive the redirect. |
| 2 | pass | Datasource list, item and alias settle on Setup with no `/studio` entry; the list shows `showcase_external`; `metadata-edit-datasource` renders. |
| 3 | pass | The bookmark lands on `/studio/~all/metadata/flow` (33 rows), and with a package on its Automations pillar. |

Chains were read from a `history.pushState` / `replaceState` hook with client-side navigation, plus full loads for the list, the datasource and the bookmark.

## Reproduction rules

1. **A published dashboard or report override drops the item from the base's export** (restore-display, clause 4; product defect). Reproduced before and after a restart.
   1. On a fresh showcase, `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/export`: `dashboards[]` holds `showcase_ops_dashboard`.
   2. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`; `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` with the item and `overrides: {package:'com.example.showcase', basedOn:'0.1.0'}`; `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase.custom/publish-drafts`.
   3. Repeat step 1's read. Expected: the item byte-identical to step 1. Actual: absent. The same happens with report `showcase_hours_by_status`. View `showcase_task.in_progress` stays. Removing the override brings the item back.
2. **New similar on a flow with a live override is refused** (off-clause; product defect). Reproduced twice in Studio and once over the API. Publish an override of `showcase_budget_approval`, then `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_budget_approval/clone` with `{name:'showcase_budget_approval_copy', label:'x'}`. Expected: a switched-off copy in the pair (ADR-0146 D4). Actual: 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE, "declares an override of 'com.example.showcase', which ships no flow named 'showcase_budget_approval_copy'". After Restore the same call answers 200.

## Derived

- **PASS (6), FAIL (1):** `studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display`, clause 4.
- PARTIAL, BLOCKED and NOT-RUN: none. No fixture gaps.
- `packages-export-base-unchanged-per-type.integration.test.ts` is green while clause 4 fails live: on its harness the per-package layer lists both documents, and on the showcase boot it does not hold the base's.

## Off-clause observations, not extracted

- At a 1024 px wide pane, the selected customized row in the flow rail showed only its mark, with the name squeezed out.
- At the same width, the item header's more menu (`if-item-more`, `auto-item-more`) sits under the right panel until the panel is collapsed.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_task/layers`: `code.fields.assignee.label` reads the patched label, not the shipped one.
- The clone's notice sentence "The copy is switched off…" renders in English in a zh-CN console.

Links back: #29560, #28579, #28236.
